meta.title: One-click DSH restart
meta.description: A restart button that can live in several seats, an automatic end-of-reply prompt, and an optional detached supervisor: restarts the whole DeepSeek Harness app and Host, so a rebuilt plugin or composition takes effect immediately.

state.timeout: The request timed out, so no restart was confirmed.
